title: Find Maximum Element
description: Given an array of integers, find and print the maximum element in the array.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer n, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains n space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print the maximum element in the array.
explanation: Traverse the array while keeping track of the largest value encountered. After processing all elements, print the maximum value.

examples.explanation: The largest element in the array is 9.
-1 is greater than all other elements in the array.

testCases.explanation: The maximum value is 9.
The maximum value is -1.
A single-element array has that element as its maximum.
The maximum is the last element.
The least negative value is the maximum.
The maximum value can occur more than once.

title: Find Second Largest Element
description: Given an array of integers, find and print the second largest distinct element in the array.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 100000
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9
The array contains at least two distinct elements.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer n, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains n space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print the second largest distinct element in the array.
explanation: Find the largest and second largest distinct values while traversing the array. If the current value is greater than the largest value, move the largest value to second largest. Otherwise, if it is between the largest and second largest values, update the second largest value.
